header.title: Visit
header.intro: What to know before you go, explained in pictures as well as words.

official.title: Hours, tickets and booking
official.body: Opening hours and ticket prices change, and our sources do not agree on them. Please check the official reservation page before you go.

rules.title: Before you go
rules.intro: Pictograms for the visitor rules listed on the official reservation page, readable whatever language you speak.
rules.keyProhibited: Ring with a bar: not allowed
rules.keyGuidance: Plain ring: please do, or good to know

items.keep-off-grass: Keep off the grass and plants

plan.title: Site plan
plan.intro: A schematic plan of the spaces described on this site. Select a number to read about a place.
plan.disclaimer: Schematic and not to scale: positions follow written descriptions, not a survey, and do not show which areas are open to visitors.
